acceptance: Before the cut, record the chosen unused version, intended origin/develop base SHA, live v0.4.1 branch/PR disposition, current release-only and v-tag rulesets, and latest completed green canary run whose checked develop SHA is applicable and under 48 hours old.

Create the release branch from the exact intended origin/develop head in a clean linked worktree; review the curated tree and CHANGELOG on the release PR's exact head; confirm validate-base and release-required-result are required and green on that head.
Confirm the release PR is MERGED with mergedAt and merge commit; verify vX.Y.Z points to that commit on release, and record the matching release.yml run and protected PyPI approval.
Verify the built-wheel installation matrix, PyPI version/files and clean installation, and GitHub Release assets/notes from live endpoints before reporting publication complete.

After publication, prepare and land the separate develop version-sync PR and run the release-accounting check; report package publication, site publication, advisory UAT, and tracker completion as distinct states.

description: Carry the next Python package release only after the blocking canary and release-tooling repairs are delivered. Decision 1: the maintainer selects an unused X.Y.Z after checking PyPI, GitHub tags/releases, and the closed unmerged v0.4.1 PR/remote branch; record whether v0.4.1 is reused or deliberately superseded before any branch sweep. Decision 2: confirm the release scope and hand-curated CHANGELOG/release tree on the exact PR head; UAT, stress, and live-cloud campaigns remain advisory under the current runbook unless a later policy decision changes that. Decision 3: the named human approves the protected pypi environment when release.yml reaches publish. This tracker item does not itself authorize a cut, merge, tag, PyPI approval, or site publication; execute those actions only in a later release request with the chosen version. The package release is separate from independent benchbox.dev publication. Prior art: docs/operations/release-guide.md, Makefile release-cut/release-finalize, release-canary.yml, and release.yml. Use the fixed linked-worktree flow and preserve the dirty primary clone, unrelated worktrees, and v* branches until their ownership and disposition are known. Never use an emergency canary override for routine failures, bypass required contexts, force-push or replace a public tag, or infer completion from a pushed tag or green PR.
